**Nothing can speed up how fast your body metabolizes alcohol** once it enters your bloodstream. Your liver breaks down alcohol at a relatively fixed rate—averaging about one standard drink per hour—`using enzymes like alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH)`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF166OJQ8vkM_k9ZJLh2xa_A4YSLsviqc2HtZ0N_-b_Q7d0eXdqFSutqs-qOYmpoFs4vg19SsZrOYjtSiAbT-WQ4DrXDuIxVgaN_1ZPdfglTlhGOzkU3FKOt6A6kKnBN0xMZtjwb80pMAplJse0YgRVJ2a0Led1_oyMgHHZaL74914VusFLbuJ5wWX_jfauTtp1vWk7Y7606GC)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1yCrnp4IFS0NbNn3XPLa0jRa2adOTwQsxJRnB5oR_-LMbjc2trSJmi1QRBcmVG46zJDSc2CKdJuisRV-P7WOuppx6vC9y9E0mSZlQDFAOYTJazksIlYTVochDH5rOaS8b1rSQT4ftiS4Rs-9IjA-EupQMQwS9W_3z6Q8ISYNEEYaHyy6SC3kPtte5CtuLrm103yt)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXVP48nqSgYwaxaLKIhaoFTqGw72jMz3I1EvDomlyNSBRZA8f1AnxwmEtvXo_O7HWu77TcGJtvrGDB4Wv03qCGYEC_S3ykGU9LY5YptNOP1-q5o0BrHac6hOGYlNa37fpxpohgdPUmBZQ37xEVpksMEB4)

### What Actually Happens With Common "Fixes"

- **Time:** Only time allows your liver to clear alcohol and lower your blood alcohol concentration (BAC).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX6s4NLQhvi_SRwiVjXy_ysKS4Z5TPLrzDVHwel1QgV-XkjkQ7svQnCDOKj31pmHvqpgCXbXVEG7pi5q-aXpWYHu00tc4zdlaUvV9y8RT9ISbHw0ygJasYGh_XJkPzfUZvKYx8WJCaEe4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF166OJQ8vkM_k9ZJLh2xa_A4YSLsviqc2HtZ0N_-b_Q7d0eXdqFSutqs-qOYmpoFs4vg19SsZrOYjtSiAbT-WQ4DrXDuIxVgaN_1ZPdfglTlhGOzkU3FKOt6A6kKnBN0xMZtjwb80pMAplJse0YgRVJ2a0Led1_oyMgHHZaL74914VusFLbuJ5wWX_jfauTtp1vWk7Y7606GC)
- **Water and food:** Drinking water and eating help manage dehydration, slow alcohol absorption when eaten beforehand, and ease symptoms, but they do not accelerate liver metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXcRJNfrjfDXhxGHjhLuXNjR_CDXnaJi-kPy3bMCzNBaTx50PkTiFeimRzm5TnaD4y4teglIxfKt7xQwfc8myTVnhu52cnTHjtdRhOZW3X2Aq2yOynpf-KxnHCCPrf-7prtributMNGjSMJroyMqpLNbK-E6IBmU6TpA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF18l3xAjB4B5V331oiCiOUFm_89BA3Y0OrXMIKL-7dV0PIsU10rLflpnZ9sDzf0TNsmMKvXmejZEMSofwgkEha8iJ61oRckujwYHGTPNiK6U4-8w9lWDWWNMhbgZbipY5wO3AX-w00TwD1IdY5YDs3XS_WYWXd-Nbpn7K2svlJfLxPRT2)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX6s4NLQhvi_SRwiVjXy_ysKS4Z5TPLrzDVHwel1QgV-XkjkQ7svQnCDOKj31pmHvqpgCXbXVEG7pi5q-aXpWYHu00tc4zdlaUvV9y8RT9ISbHw0ygJasYGh_XJkPzfUZvKYx8WJCaEe4)
- **Coffee, energy drinks, and cold showers:** These may make you feel more awake or alert, but they do not lower your BAC or clear alcohol faster.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1yCrnp4IFS0NbNn3XPLa0jRa2adOTwQsxJRnB5oR_-LMbjc2trSJmi1QRBcmVG46zJDSc2CKdJuisRV-P7WOuppx6vC9y9E0mSZlQDFAOYTJazksIlYTVochDH5rOaS8b1rSQT4ftiS4Rs-9IjA-EupQMQwS9W_3z6Q8ISYNEEYaHyy6SC3kPtte5CtuLrm103yt)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF166OJQ8vkM_k9ZJLh2xa_A4YSLsviqc2HtZ0N_-b_Q7d0eXdqFSutqs-qOYmpoFs4vg19SsZrOYjtSiAbT-WQ4DrXDuIxVgaN_1ZPdfglTlhGOzkU3FKOt6A6kKnBN0xMZtjwb80pMAplJse0YgRVJ2a0Led1_oyMgHHZaL74914VusFLbuJ5wWX_jfauTtp1vWk7Y7606GC)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF18l3xAjB4B5V331oiCiOUFm_89BA3Y0OrXMIKL-7dV0PIsU10rLflpnZ9sDzf0TNsmMKvXmejZEMSofwgkEha8iJ61oRckujwYHGTPNiK6U4-8w9lWDWWNMhbgZbipY5wO3AX-w00TwD1IdY5YDs3XS_WYWXd-Nbpn7K2svlJfLxPRT2)
- **Sleep and exercise:** Sleeping lets time pass and helps recovery, while exercise may slightly affect elimination or alertness, neither offers a reliable shortcut to sobering up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF18l3xAjB4B5V331oiCiOUFm_89BA3Y0OrXMIKL-7dV0PIsU10rLflpnZ9sDzf0TNsmMKvXmejZEMSofwgkEha8iJ61oRckujwYHGTPNiK6U4-8w9lWDWWNMhbgZbipY5wO3AX-w00TwD1IdY5YDs3XS_WYWXd-Nbpn7K2svlJfLxPRT2)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF166OJQ8vkM_k9ZJLh2xa_A4YSLsviqc2HtZ0N_-b_Q7d0eXdqFSutqs-qOYmpoFs4vg19SsZrOYjtSiAbT-WQ4DrXDuIxVgaN_1ZPdfglTlhGOzkU3FKOt6A6kKnBN0xMZtjwb80pMAplJse0YgRVJ2a0Led1_oyMgHHZaL74914VusFLbuJ5wWX_jfauTtp1vWk7Y7606GC)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX6s4NLQhvi_SRwiVjXy_ysKS4Z5TPLrzDVHwel1QgV-XkjkQ7svQnCDOKj31pmHvqpgCXbXVEG7pi5q-aXpWYHu00tc4zdlaUvV9y8RT9ISbHw0ygJasYGh_XJkPzfUZvKYx8WJCaEe4)

### What Can Slow Alcohol Processing Down

- **Liver conditions:** Reduced liver function slows how efficiently alcohol is broken down.
- **Medications:** Certain drugs—such as acetaminophen (Tylenol)—compete for liver processing and can cause liver strain or slow metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXcRJNfrjfDXhxGHjhLuXNjR_CDXnaJi-kPy3bMCzNBaTx50PkTiFeimRzm5TnaD4y4teglIxfKt7xQwfc8myTVnhu52cnTHjtdRhOZW3X2Aq2yOynpf-KxnHCCPrf-7prtributMNGjSMJroyMqpLNbK-E6IBmU6TpA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF166OJQ8vkM_k9ZJLh2xa_A4YSLsviqc2HtZ0N_-b_Q7d0eXdqFSutqs-qOYmpoFs4vg19SsZrOYjtSiAbT-WQ4DrXDuIxVgaN_1ZPdfglTlhGOzkU3FKOt6A6kKnBN0xMZtjwb80pMAplJse0YgRVJ2a0Led1_oyMgHHZaL74914VusFLbuJ5wWX_jfauTtp1vWk7Y7606GC)
